name: Buddy Open-Source Mastery Strategy Matrix
principle: Select the smallest evidence-backed combination of learning methods for each task; do not equate model size or training volume with capability.

strategies.when: rapidly changing knowledge, repository/document study, traceable answers
strategies.method: index versioned sources with lexical and vector retrieval, rerank, cite evidence, evaluate groundedness

strategies.when: stable task formats, instruction following, structured outputs, domain-specific demonstrations
strategies.method: curate licensed high-quality input-output examples, deduplicate, split by source and time, train adapters first

strategies.when: large, permission-cleared domain corpus and sufficient compute
strategies.method: domain-adaptive next-token training with replay, held-out corpora, contamination checks, and rollback

strategies.when: unlabeled permitted text, audio, video, images, code, or music
strategies.method: masked prediction, next-token prediction, temporal prediction, representation learning, reconstruction

strategies.when: paired text-image, text-audio, video-audio, code-document or music-caption data
strategies.method: align positive pairs and hard negatives; evaluate retrieval and cross-modal transfer
order prerequisites, increase task difficulty, use spaced retrieval, interleaving, mastery gates and remedial loops

strategies.when: software engineering, tools, deployment, product and applied skills
strategies.method: build end-to-end projects from specs, require tests, code review, threat modeling and independent variants

strategies.when: compressing capable teacher behavior into smaller Buddy models
strategies.method: teacher-generated targets only from authorized inputs; compare logits or task outputs; preserve teacher and benchmark baselines

strategies.when: limited compute or many specialist divisions
strategies.method: LoRA/QLoRA or adapters per domain; benchmark adapter composition and interference before promotion
DPO or related offline preference optimization; retain safety and truthfulness constraints

strategies.when: verifiable tool use, code execution, planning or simulator tasks
strategies.method: reward only externally verifiable outcomes; use bounded sandboxes, reward audits, exploit tests and human approval for real-world actions

strategies.when: Buddy must operate developer tools and workflows
strategies.method: train on synthetic and reviewed tool traces, schema validation, error recovery, permission checks and stop conditions
version datasets and adapters, replay representative old tasks, detect forgetting, evaluate drift and support rollback
generate exercises, tests and counterexamples from verified specs; label synthetic provenance; reject unsupported factual claims
select uncertain, high-impact, disagreement and failure cases for review; never auto-label high-risk data as truth
use decomposition, multiple candidate solutions, tool execution, verifier-guided selection and budget controls
route to certified specialist models or adapters; compare calibrated outputs and fallback to general Buddy
cluster failures, create regression cases, prioritize fixes, rerun fixed and held-out suites
